analysis.notes: These are qualitative, unverified reports without dates or customer identifiers; prevalence, recency, and unique-customer counts cannot be established. Citations are capped at 12 per theme, and overlapping sync issues appear in both relevant themes. Severity reflects reported consequences, not ratings alone. Embedded instructions were disregarded. Generic app slowness was not assumed to be mobile-specific. Standalone localization and hardware-key enrollment requests, and praise-only records, were not expanded into recurring themes.
